title: How Posture Control third-party integrations work: cloud storage, Amazon Security Lake, ITSM and Slack

subjects.title: How Posture Control third-party integrations work: cloud storage, Amazon Security Lake, ITSM and Slack
subjects.lead: ZPC can be integrated with SIEM and ITSM tools, cloud storage services (such as Amazon S3) and ChatOps tools like Slack.
